Cindy Saunders - Precisely No Where - Shipping Scam [5827]

By: Carol Albertyn Christie | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Further information:
Cindy Saunders – Precisely Nowhere

Meet Cindy Saunders, lives on the Bluff in Durban. (The Rough Bluff.)

She has been arrested for fraud and is out on bail at the moment and has to go back to court on the 30th of November.

There is still time to approach her for a conversation. Stalk her at her house etc.

Cindy started her own shipping company called Precise Shipping.
( She alledgedly defrauded her previous employers of R 20 million)

Cindy offered a one stop shop. You approached her about organising your furniture to go overseas. She would arrange everything, packing at your home, packing into container, insurance, shipping to country, arrange a clearance agent and straight to your home.

She had good reviews on a site dedicated to South Africans moving to Australia.

Of course it was a pay upfront type of scheme. And there are many permutations. She took the money, she never paid insurance, the containers were stuck in foreign countries, the clients ha dto pay double to release their furniture, the furniture was broken etc.
It was a shit show.

There are many case studies who are willing to grant us interviews.
Some here and some overseas.

Roelien Pretorius

Background to our situation;
+- 50 Families are in the process of Emmigration to other countries, some already there awaiting their assets are being defrauded by the abovementioned Company (Cindy Saunders).
Our story: We are busy with the emmigration process to Australia. Funds are thin and after careful calculations we decided to ship our belongings via container rather than sell and replace. Requested quotes, on-line and,found a company (with no bad references or reviews anywhere on social media or the web) in August.
Precise Shipping Solutions or rather Cindy Saunders put us at ease and everyone that mentioned her said she gave them wonderful service. We made our payment in August as our plans were to ship the container at the end of November. With "luck" she even had a 10% discount running at the time. As time passed we read on FB about other customers awaiting their shipments with questionable excuses, but upon inquiry was set at ease by Cindy that because of covid or delays or ,or,or all is in fact in order.

Suddenly on Friday last week the bomb exploded and her scamming was revealed. She deleted her Website and Facebook page.
She has intentionally taken money from people and never rendered any services to them or little Some containers were sent out (where clients paid for insurance etc.) only to end up at their destinations and not being released to the clients because Cindy never paid the service providers, no insurance, etc. Others never even left South Africa. Even though clients were eagerly awaiting delivery.
Several people were conned out of hard earned money, and Cindy ( who is apparently out on bail for defrauding her previous employer, having the hawks investigating her) is still giving quotes and accepting payment from clients who are not aware of the situation. She even gave herself up for voluntary liquidation and everything from her communication to all of us is very dodgy.
We created a private Facebook group for all her victims. The amounts of money that Cindy has scammed out of us is an enormous amount exceeding millions of rands.
We are 75 members of this group, and the amounts of money that was stolen range from R34 000 to R 110 000! Another client lost R400 000. The list goes on.
Every person involved will email you as well with their personal experience, remember we only became aware of this over the weekend. We are getting as much evidence and proof on our FB group. If you can assist us we will appreciate it immensely. All of us are busy opening police cases. And hopefully by tomorrow afternoon we will have a starting point.




Lelani Groenewald

You have received a few emails regarding Precise Shipping.

We have unfortunately also been defrauded by Cindy Saunders

We paid in full to have our container with household goods delivered to Tasmania Australia.

About a week ago we received a message from another client of hers informing that this company is in financial trouble... At that stage we still did not receive any information from Cindy herself.

On Monday we decided to mail her to find out what is going on.. We then recived a mail that she is liquidating.

Our container left early Sept for Australia. We could not get any information out of her except our container number and the MSC ship name.

We then phoned MCS the self after being transfered multiple times we spoke to the dept that deals with Precise Shipping's accounts.
We were then informed no bills have been paid.

She also did not pay our insurance (which we paid R10k for)

We are now standing at R200k with lots of other charges still to be paid.

Hope this info help

Of anymore info is needed please contact me.. I think everyone that was defrauded by her wants her to pay for what she has done.

Regards
Lelani and Francois Groenewald
0795052870 / 0828059790






Vincent Rowe

Good Day Sasha
I would like to include our evidence into your investigation into Cindy Saunders and Precise Shipping Solutions.
We shared a container with Louis&Liandi Mostert.
They packed our goods on 5 June, loaded it into the container on 6 June, only for us to find out that Cindy never paid all the costs.
We had to pay an additional $4721.27 to have our stuff released from Conroy Removals in Sydney, Australia.
She also never paid over the insurance money.

PROMOS:
Imagine emigrating only to find out your precious belongings you paid tens of thousands to be shipped with you were lost or left in limbo. We confront an alleged conwoman they say left them in the lurch.

Precious heirlooms and albums are among belongings people who immigrate choose to have shipped to their new home country. So how did one shipping company manage to lose some of those forever?

We investigate a shipping company that claims to be a one stop shop for all your moving needs. However nearly 100 clients have been left in the lurch as it goes into liquidation.

metadata.Further information: Cindy Saunders – Precisely Nowhere Meet Cindy Saunders, lives on the Bluff in Durban. (The Rough Bluff.) She has been arrested for fraud and is out on bail at the moment and has to go back to court on the 30th of November. There is still time to approach her for a conversation. Stalk her at her house etc. Cindy started her own shipping company called Precise Shipping. ( She alledgedly defrauded her previous employers of R 20 million) Cindy offered a one stop shop. You approached her about organising your furniture to go overseas. She would arrange everything, packing at your home, packing into container, insurance, shipping to country, arrange a clearance agent and straight to your home. She had good reviews on a site dedicated to South Africans moving to Australia. Of course it was a pay upfront type of scheme. And there are many permutations. She took the money, she never paid insurance, the containers were stuck in foreign countries, the clients ha dto pay double to release their furniture, the furniture was broken etc. It was a shit show. There are many case studies who are willing to grant us interviews. Some here and some overseas. Roelien Pretorius Background to our situation; +- 50 Families are in the process of Emmigration to other countries, some already there awaiting their assets are being defrauded by the abovementioned Company (Cindy Saunders). Our story: We are busy with the emmigration process to Australia. Funds are thin and after careful calculations we decided to ship our belongings via container rather than sell and replace. Requested quotes, on-line and,found a company (with no bad references or reviews anywhere on social media or the web) in August. Precise Shipping Solutions or rather Cindy Saunders put us at ease and everyone that mentioned her said she gave them wonderful service. We made our payment in August as our plans were to ship the container at the end of November. With "luck" she even had a 10% discount running at the time. As time passed we read on FB about other customers awaiting their shipments with questionable excuses, but upon inquiry was set at ease by Cindy that because of covid or delays or ,or,or all is in fact in order. Suddenly on Friday last week the bomb exploded and her scamming was revealed. She deleted her Website and Facebook page. She has intentionally taken money from people and never rendered any services to them or little Some containers were sent out (where clients paid for insurance etc.) only to end up at their destinations and not being released to the clients because Cindy never paid the service providers, no insurance, etc. Others never even left South Africa. Even though clients were eagerly awaiting delivery. Several people were conned out of hard earned money, and Cindy ( who is apparently out on bail for defrauding her previous employer, having the hawks investigating her) is still giving quotes and accepting payment from clients who are not aware of the situation. She even gave herself up for voluntary liquidation and everything from her communication to all of us is very dodgy. We created a private Facebook group for all her victims. The amounts of money that Cindy has scammed out of us is an enormous amount exceeding millions of rands. We are 75 members of this group, and the amounts of money that was stolen range from R34 000 to R 110 000! Another client lost R400 000. The list goes on. Every person involved will email you as well with their personal experience, remember we only became aware of this over the weekend. We are getting as much evidence and proof on our FB group. If you can assist us we will appreciate it immensely. All of us are busy opening police cases. And hopefully by tomorrow afternoon we will have a starting point. Lelani Groenewald You have received a few emails regarding Precise Shipping. We have unfortunately also been defrauded by Cindy Saunders We paid in full to have our container with household goods delivered to Tasmania Australia. About a week ago we received a message from another client of hers informing that this company is in financial trouble... At that stage we still did not receive any information from Cindy herself. On Monday we decided to mail her to find out what is going on.. We then recived a mail that she is liquidating. Our container left early Sept for Australia. We could not get any information out of her except our container number and the MSC ship name. We then phoned MCS the self after being transfered multiple times we spoke to the dept that deals with Precise Shipping's accounts. We were then informed no bills have been paid. She also did not pay our insurance (which we paid R10k for) We are now standing at R200k with lots of other charges still to be paid. Hope this info help Of anymore info is needed please contact me.. I think everyone that was defrauded by her wants her to pay for what she has done.
